tasks.short: Assess competition performance and adjust future performance

steps.what: Locate and watch actual competition footage and inspect the athlete's existing performance results
inputs: actual competition video and athlete identity

steps.what: Assess actual athletic performance, identifying technical, tactical and physical strengths and weaknesses
inputs: athlete's actual experience and coach feedback
outputs: athlete's assessed performance strengths and weaknesses

steps.what: Make actual technical or tactical practice adjustments in response to assessed competition performance
inputs: athlete's assessed performance strengths and weaknesses
actual training conditions and existing coaching guidance

tasks.design: Configure native athlete/event filters and bookmarks in {OTHER}, the sports video/results application. The athlete still watches the actual footage, assesses performance and practises adjustments; the software only shortens navigation and does not generate coaching or a new performance report.
tasks.previous_blocker: Repeated navigation to the athlete's own competition moments can interrupt review.
tasks.enabler_now: Native event/athlete filters can expose existing footage and results.
tasks.still_hard: Effective adjustment depends on embodied experience and actual practice.
tasks.human_edge: Recognise why a technically visible mistake occurred under competition pressure.

ambition.what: No athletic-performance improvement or extra training capacity claimed.

build_days.consent_and_access: 2-5 for footage/results rights and athlete/staff consultation where applicable

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: native sports-video filters can reduce navigation while performance interpretation and physical adjustment remain athlete work.

assumptions: Shares describe an unmeasured video-supported review/practice episode, not a measured athlete baseline.

Competition organisers/video staff supply actual footage/results with existing event/athlete identity. Athlete selection and watching remain in s1; no free new clip tagging or biomechanical data is assumed.
Only navigation changes; equivalent current filters remove the gain. Coach labour is not counted as athlete saving and all athlete discussion remains counted in s2.
Gross provisional saving 1.5 minus 0.5 hour of bookmark/filter upkeep gives 1 net.

This episode makes actual practice adjustments and has no separate written training-plan update or message. Where such an actual record is required it needs separate capture effort, not a presumed saving.
research_questions: Do native filters remove repeated athlete navigation without losing relevant competition context?

incremental.description: Maintain athlete/event bookmarks and filter checks

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Below provisional net 1%; actual viewing, assessment and practice remain.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Represent sports clubs in media, speeches and charity events

steps.what: Read the actual club/event brief, purpose and agreed factual talking points before the appearance
inputs: actual agreed event facts and athlete responsibilities
outputs: athlete-read appearance context and factual limits

steps.what: Represent the team or sports club through actual media discussion, live speech or charity-event participation
inputs: athlete-read appearance context and factual limits
actual media, audience or charity participants
outputs: actual athlete representation and audience interaction

tasks.design: Configure a native current-event brief link in {DOCS}. The athlete reads the actual brief and performs the live appearance; no speech-writing service, follow-up report or social-media publication is assumed.
tasks.previous_blocker: Finding the current event brief can add small repeated navigation effort.
tasks.enabler_now: A native event-to-brief link can expose the actual current instructions.
tasks.still_hard: Authentic representation and responding to real people depend on the athlete.
tasks.human_edge: Speak credibly about the club while responding to the actual audience.

ambition.what: No automatic representation or audience-growth claim.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: native event-brief links can reduce retrieval while live sports-club representation remains human work.

assumptions: Shares describe an unmeasured actual briefed appearance, not a newly invented publicity-administration baseline.
Club/event staff produce the actual brief and factual talking points; athlete reading/checking is counted in s1. No structured script is assumed.
Only retrieval changes; equivalent current linking removes the gain. Live speech and interaction remain fully retained.
Gross provisional saving 0.5 minus 0.25 hour of brief-link upkeep gives 0.25 net. This live appearance includes no separate file send or record commitment.
unknowns: Actual briefing practices and retrieval burden
research_questions: Is current-brief retrieval a recurring burden for actual appearances?

already_counted.description: Read and check actual appearance context

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Below provisional net 0.25%; the actual appearance is unchanged.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Lead an athletic team as captain

steps.what: Read the actual team and competition situation, listening to teammates and observing their readiness
inputs: actual teammates, competition situation and coach instructions
outputs: captain's situational understanding of team needs

steps.what: Lead teammates through actual captain's communication, encouragement and resolution of team tensions
inputs: captain's situational understanding of team needs
outputs: actual team leadership communication and response

steps.what: Set the actual example of effort, conduct and team cooperation during athletic participation
inputs: actual team leadership communication and response

tasks.design: Keep actual captaincy with the athlete. A {CHAT} or {PROJECT} tool does not replace reading the team, speaking to teammates or leading through conduct in this live captaincy episode; no new captain's report or messaging baseline is introduced.
tasks.previous_blocker: The work depends on the captain's live understanding and credibility.
tasks.enabler_now: No specific native configuration or automation changes these actual leadership steps.
tasks.still_hard: Team trust and changing competitive pressure require personal judgment.
tasks.human_edge: Know when a teammate needs challenge, reassurance or quiet support.

ambition.what: No change in captaincy authority or leadership capacity.

build_days.consent_and_access: 0; no system change or new data access

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: live athletic captaincy depends on situational judgment, interpersonal trust and demonstrated conduct.

assumptions: Shares are provisional live captaincy effort, not a measured baseline.
Actual teammates, coach instructions and live conditions are the inputs; no structured team-state feed is assumed.
Native chat/templates were considered: this episode has no actual record write, report, file lookup or discrete send that they would change. Adding those tasks would invent a baseline.
All actual steps remain fully retained. Gross and net saving are zero; incremental upkeep is zero because no system change is proposed.
unknowns: Any actual separate captain-owned scheduling or record duties
research_questions: Does the captain actually perform separate recurring record or message work that should be assessed in its own workflow?

incremental.description: No new system or upkeep proposed

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Unchanged live captaincy; no actual record or discrete send is hidden inside the three retained steps.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

skills_to_grow: Lead teammates through judgment and conduct
role.ambitious_version: Reduce small evidence and brief navigation burdens while retaining embodied athletic improvement, public representation and captaincy.
